modelResponses.text: I would prioritize quiet rooms while retaining some shared workspaces. Student A is right that collaboration matters, but group work can often take place in ordinary classrooms outside teaching hours. Students who need silence have fewer alternatives when every open area is noisy. A university could also make the rooms flexible: movable partitions would allow a group room to become several small quiet rooms during examination periods. Booking data could then help staff adjust the balance each term. This approach would provide a dependable place for concentrated reading without assuming that students always study in the same way.

content.text: 该参考从资源可替代性提出观点，回应同学意见，并提供可移动隔断和使用数据作为新贡献。100 词是有效回答建议，不是低于该字数自动判零；仍须依据任务完成度与语言表现整体评价。
